goal: 成功问到路并确认路线

n1.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n1.line: Hi there! You look a little lost. Can I help you with something?
n1.lineCn: 您好!您看起来有点迷路了。有什么可以帮忙的吗?

grammar.name: 方位介词
grammar.note: 本课重点:along, across, past, at, near 等介词描述方位和路线。

options.text: Yes, please! I am looking for the City Library. Is it far from here?
options.textCn: 太好了!我在找市图书馆。它离这儿远吗?
options.feedback: 礼貌求助,还问了距离,信息明确。
只有一个词,对方不明白你想问什么。
明明迷路了却说没事,错过帮助机会。

n2.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n2.line: It is not far. Go straight along this road, and turn left at the second crossing. You will see it on your right.
n2.lineCn: 不远。沿着这条路直走,在第二个十字路口左转,图书馆就在你的右手边。

grammar.name: along / at / on 的用法
grammar.note: along 表"沿着",at the crossing 表"在路口",on your right 表"在你的右边"。

options.text: Got it. So I go straight along this road, turn left at the second crossing, and the library is on my right. Is that right?
options.textCn: 明白了。我沿着这条路直走,在第二个路口左转,图书馆在我右手边,对吗?
options.feedback: 完整复述路线并确认,方向感满分。
没听清细节就离开,大概率会走错。

n3.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n3.line: Sorry, I am not sure what you need. Are you looking for a place, like a shop or a building?
n3.lineCn: 抱歉,我不太确定您需要什么。您是在找某个地方吗,比如商店或大楼?

grammar.name: 介词表地点
grammar.note: like a shop 中 like 是介词表"像",描述场所类别。

options.text: I am looking for the City Library. I was told it is across from a big park.
options.textCn: 我在找市图书馆。有人告诉我在一个大公园的对面。
options.feedback: 说清目的地,还补充了标志性参照物。

options.text: Never mind, I will use my phone.
options.feedback: 拒绝帮助,等手机没电就麻烦了。

n4.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n4.line: Exactly! The library is across from the park, past the big supermarket. Walk past the bank, and you will see it near the bridge.
n4.lineCn: 完全正确!图书馆在公园对面,经过大超市再往前。走过银行,桥边就能看到它。

grammar.name: past / across from / near
grammar.note: past 表"经过",across from 表"在对面",near 表"在附近"。

options.text: Let me repeat: past the bank, across from the park, near the bridge. Am I going in the right direction?
options.textCn: 我重复一下:经过银行,公园对面,桥附近。我走的方向对吗?
options.feedback: 再次复述关键地标,确认行进方向,非常可靠。

options.text: That is too much information. I will just walk around.
options.textCn: 信息太多了,我还是随便逛逛吧。
options.feedback: 不想记路线,很可能再次迷路。

n5.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n5.line: Wait, please listen carefully! At the second crossing, turn left. Then keep walking along the street for about five minutes.
n5.lineCn: 等等,请仔细听!在第二个路口左转,然后沿着街再走大约五分钟。

grammar.name: At / along 介词的精确使用
grammar.note: at the crossing 表路口处,along the street 表沿着街道。

options.text: Thank you for repeating! So it is at the second crossing, not the first one. Got it now.
options.textCn: 谢谢您再说一遍!是第二个路口,不是第一个。现在记住了。
options.feedback: 细心确认关键信息,路线终于清晰。

options.text: I am in a hurry. I will figure it out by myself.
options.textCn: 我赶时间,我自己想办法吧。
options.feedback: 急急忙忙离开,方向还没搞清楚。

n6.speaker: 路人 Stranger
n6.line: You are on the right track. From here, walk straight for two blocks, and the library will be in front of you. Easy, right?
n6.lineCn: 你走的方向没错。从这里直走两个街区,图书馆就在你正前方。容易吧?

grammar.name: in front of 表方位
grammar.note: in front of 表"在……正前方",是常见的方位介词短语。

options.text: Yes! Walk straight for two blocks, and it is in front of me. Thank you so much for your help!
options.textCn: 对!直走两个街区,它就在我正前方。太感谢您的帮助了!
options.feedback: 完整确认最终路线并道谢,问路成功。

options.text: Wait, is it in front of the bank or behind it? I am confused again.
options.textCn: 等等,它是在银行前面还是后面?我又糊涂了。
options.feedback: 路线已经清楚,却还不断追问,让路人无语。

success.speaker: 路人 Stranger
success.line: You are very welcome! Have a nice day at the library!
success.lineCn: 不客气!祝您在图书馆度过愉快的一天!

fail1.speaker: 路人 Stranger
fail1.line: Alright, take care and good luck finding the library!
fail1.lineCn: 好吧,路上小心,祝您顺利找到图书馆!

fail2.speaker: 路人 Stranger
fail2.line: Haha, take it easy. Just remember: two blocks and you are there. Good luck!
fail2.lineCn: 哈哈,别紧张。记住:两个街区就到了,祝你好运!
